mentions.name: Kafkaesque
mentions.description: A wire-protocol compatible Kafka mocking service. It stands in for real Kafka so developers can exercise code in tests without running embedded or dockerised Kafka instances.
mentions.problem: Testing against Kafka typically requires running embedded or dockerised Kafka, which the tool replaces with a lightweight mock.
mentions.audience: Developers who currently use embedded or dockerised Kafka in their tests.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Kafkaesque, a wire-protocol compatible Kafka mocking service.

Worth kicking the wheels if you're currently using embedded or dockerised Kafka in your tests.
